summary: Appellant convicted under Sections 302 and 376 IPC for raping and murdering 6-year-old niece based on circumstantial evidence including last seen theory. Prosecution relied on testimonies of PWs 1-3; defense alleged false implication by Zalim Khan over property dispute. Courts applied Section 106 Evidence Act burden on accused. High Court confirmed death penalty as rarest of rare case. Appellant challenged witness credibility, FIR delay, lack of forensic evidence, and procedural defects in Section 313 CrPC questioning.
legal_provisions_cited: Sharad Birdhichand Sarda vs. State of Maharashtra
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; death sentence commuted to life imprisonment based on unreliability of circumstantial evidence and reasonable doubt regarding prosecution case.
